mapper.select: /* isry.cysns.casemng.caseaftfct.mapper.selectReqById - Lee MS */ SELECT MIN(DECODE(A.QUSTNB_SHAPE_SE_CD, '06', '1')) AS QUSTNB_SHAPE1, /* 정신건강-자살 */ MIN(DECODE(A.QUSTNB_SHAPE_SE_CD, '13', '1')) AS QUSTNB_SHAPE2, /* 정신건강-자해 */ MIN(DECODE(A.QUSTNB_SHAPE_SE_CD, '15', '1')) AS QUSTNB_SHAPE3, /* 정신건강-폭력 */ A.CASE_MNG_NO AS CASE_MNG_NO, A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AS CASE_MNG_ODRNO FROM SBB110 A WHERE A.CASE_MNG_NO = #{CASE_MNG_NO} AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = #{CASE_MNG_ODRNO} AND A.QUSTNB_SHAPE_SE_CD IN ('06', '13', '15') GROUP BY A.CASE_MNG_NO, A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO
